reason: Index of the repository's coding guidelines and the diff/webview docs this task follows.
core/ must stay pure (no vscode, no DOM); the diff model, host panel and webview have separate boundaries.
Forbidden patterns and the before-done command list; no new runtime dependency, no persisted state, read-only diff.
Fixture, assertion and mutation-check conventions; strict-mode regression and deterministic output tests.
Protocol unions, optional fields and numeric-value typing for DiffMatch, DiffSummary.renamed and the match-mode message.
Webview event ownership and DOM contracts for the toolbar toggle, badge and summary.
data-* selectors, tokens and file placement for the rename badge and rename-implied word style.
Component folder contracts for the toolbar and diff view changes.
Reuse diffWords, diffChanges, pairLevel and the existing toolbar/protocol instead of parallel helpers.
The change spans core diff, protocol, host panel, webview and manifest; use the cross-layer checklist.
Current pairing passes, id shape, rename cascade and UI surfaces that the implementation must preserve.
